people.name: Elishama
people.line: A descendant of Jerahmeel from the tribe of Judah.

people.name: Jekamiah
people.line: Son of Shallum, a descendant of Judah.

people.name: Shallum
people.line: Son of Sismai, descendant of Judah

translations.web: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
translations.bsb: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
translations.kjv: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
translations.asv: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
